prompt: Take over the abandoned village nearby and rebuild it in our style.

card.name: Reclaimed Village

site.text: The abandoned village nearby, taken over and rebuilt on its existing ground within the claim radius

style.text: Rebuilt in 'our style' (not specified): a warm, homely medieval look in wood, stone and thatch

purpose.text: Take over and rebuild an abandoned village as a home base for the player's group

story.text: The village was abandoned and is now taken over and rebuilt.

card.interpretation: You want the nearby abandoned village taken over and rebuilt. I kept the site as that existing village on its own ground, within your 64-block claim. "Our style" wasn't described, so I used a warm medieval look. Purpose is a home base, with homes, a hall, a smithy, a market, a barn, a tower and a gate.
assumptions: Style 'our style' is unspecified; assumed medieval.
Purpose assumed to be a home base.
Budget taken from the remaining USD budget of $0.1.
Exact village location is unknown, so it will be searched for near the player.

program.notes: Gathering hall at the heart, restored from the old central building; hearth, long tables
Rebuilt on the old house plots, one per member
Forge and anvil for tools and repairs
Trading and storage near the square
